scenario.topic: Decide which food delivery platform the restaurant should join

options.name: QuickEats Delivery Service
options.upside: Offers broad delivery coverage and integrates with existing POS systems.
options.concern: Higher commission rate may reduce profit margins.

options.name: GreenBite Platform
options.upside: Lower commission rate and focuses on environmentally friendly packaging.
options.concern: Limited delivery coverage and lacks POS integration.

options.name: DineDirect Network
options.upside: Offers custom API for flexible integration and moderate commission.
options.concern: Delivery coverage excludes some rural areas.

options.name: FastPlate Express
options.upside: Lowest commission rate and simple app-based order management.
options.concern: Smaller customer base and limited delivery zones.

shared_context: The restaurant is deciding which food delivery platform to join to expand its customer base. The platforms differ in commission rates, delivery coverage, and integration features.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya manages the restaurant's technology integration and values seamless system compatibility.
personas.private_goal: To find a platform that balances integration flexibility with reasonable commission costs.

A.reason_for: Offers broad city-wide delivery and POS system compatibility.
A.reason_against: High 25% commission rate reduces profit margins.

B.reason_for: Lower 20% commission and eco-friendly packaging aligns with some values.
B.reason_against: Manual order entry complicates integration and limits efficiency.

C.reason_for: Custom API allows flexible integration and moderate 22% commission rate.

D.reason_for: Lowest commission rate and simple app-based order management.
D.reason_against: Limited delivery zones and small customer base limit growth.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is the restaurant owner focused on maximizing customer reach and revenue.
personas.private_goal: To join the platform with the largest customer base and widest delivery coverage.

A.reason_for: Largest customer base (2 million) and city-wide delivery coverage maximize sales.

B.reason_against: Smaller customer base and limited urban delivery reduce reach.

C.reason_for: Moderate commission and decent coverage in suburban and urban areas.
C.reason_against: Excludes some rural areas and smaller user base than QuickEats.

D.reason_against: Smallest customer base and limited delivery zones restrict growth.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara handles marketing and values platforms that enhance brand image and customer experience.
personas.private_goal: To partner with a platform that supports brand values and offers good exposure.

A.reason_for: Broad delivery coverage and POS integration improve customer experience and operational ease.

B.reason_for: Eco-friendly packaging aligns with brand values and lower commission rate is attractive.
B.reason_against: Limited delivery coverage and manual order entry reduce convenience.

C.reason_for: Custom API integration offers flexibility and moderate commission rate balances cost and features.
C.reason_against: Coverage excludes some rural areas, limiting reach.

D.reason_for: Lowest commission rate and simple app management.
D.reason_against: Small customer base and limited delivery zones reduce exposure.
